page.content:
Psionic sorcerer of Gelvaan whose dreams pull Bells Hells toward Ruidus.

How Imogen Temult connects

  • Faction: Bells Hells — Imogen Temult is the psionic sorcerer of Bells Hells.
  • Character: Laura Bailey — Laura Bailey plays Imogen Temult.
  • Character: Laudna — Imogen and Laudna are the paired heart of Bells Hells.

What is Imogen Temult?

Imogen Temult is Laura Bailey's Campaign 3 sorcerer, a telepath from Gelvaan whose red-storm dreams and Laudna bond sit at the center of Bells Hells.

Key threads lead to Bells Hells, Laura Bailey and Laudna.
